headline: Council passes purchase of private water system assets for up to $6 million, 8–1

meeting.summary: The deputy water director said the assets include wells, transmission lines and storage tanks, and that funding is already in the account. The department said a six-month due diligence period will show the County's total administrative costs.
meeting.recap: The Council took up buying private water system assets for up to $6 million.[[1:06:21]] The deputy water director said the assets include wells, transmission lines and storage tanks.[[1:14:02]] The water purchase passed 8–1, with the chair voting no.[[1:23:00]] The Council voted 9–0 to appoint the Lahaina applicant.[[2:17:32]]
decided: Bill 109, on the Pāʻia Sugar Mill Redevelopment Project, was sent to the Housing and Land Use Committee.
meeting.next: The water department said it will train and bring on extra employees during a transition of about six months. Bill 109 goes to the Housing and Land Use Committee.

moments.q: Opening remarks: "A Future Built on Collaboration"
